facebook: What a day at Old Lions Oval! Thabo Mokoena brought up a magnificent hundred in our Premier League Round 4 clash with Kensington Ridge CC on Saturday, 31 October, finishing with 112 off 118 balls, including 11 fours and 3 sixes. A proper captain's knock in a 50-over home fixture, and the Oval loved every minute. Take a bow, Thabo! 🦁
